scripts.cv: cd cv && latexmk -pdf -interaction=nonstopmode -halt-on-error -outdir=build cv_en.tex cv_es.tex && cp build/cv_en.pdf ../public/jesus_jimenez_alcantara_cv_en.pdf && cp build/cv_es.pdf ../public/jesus_jimenez_alcantara_cv_es.pdf
scripts.cv:private: cd cv && test -f private.tex || { echo 'Missing cv/private.tex: copy cv/private.example.tex and add your phone'; exit 1; } && latexmk -pdf -interaction=nonstopmode -halt-on-error -outdir=build-private -usepretex='\def\cvprivate{}' cv_en.tex cv_es.tex && mkdir -p private && cp build-private/cv_en.pdf private/jesus_jimenez_alcantara_cv_en.pdf && cp build-private/cv_es.pdf private/jesus_jimenez_alcantara_cv_es.pdf && echo 'Private CVs with phone: cv/private/'
